system.description: Your Sharingan can impart minor illusions onto enemies. As a Bonus action, by spending 1 Ocular Charges you can target a creature you can see within 30 feet of you that isn’t blind, forcing them to make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save they become either Berserk, Charmed, or Confused for the next minute. An affected creature remakes this saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending this effect on a success. On a success the target creature gains immunity to this evolution for the next 10 minutes.
